questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{如图，将积分分为三部分计算。原式} =I_{1}+I_{2}+I_{3} \text{，将} \Sigma \text{在}\text{ yoz }\text{平面上投影} \\ & \quad D_{yz}: 0 \leq y \leq h, -a \leq z \leq a。\text{注意到} \Sigma \text{的法线方向与} x \text{轴正方向夹锐角}，\text{则} \\ & \quad I_{1}=\iint_{\Sigma} xz \, dy \, dz = \iint_{D_{ze}} z \sqrt{a^{2}-z^{2}} \, dy \, dz。\text{因} D_{ze} \text{关于} y \text{轴对称}，\text{而被积函数为} z \text{的奇函数}，\text{故} I_{1}=0。 \\ & \quad \text{又} \Sigma \text{在} zox \text{平面上的投影域面积为零}，\text{故} I_{2}=\iint_{\Sigma} z^{2} \, dz \, dx = 0。 \\ & \quad \text{而} I_{3}=\iint_{\Sigma} xyz \, dx \, dy = \iint_{D_{ze}} xyz \left( -\frac{\partial x}{\partial z} \right) \, dy \, dz = \iint_{D_{ze}} xyz \cdot \frac{z}{x} \, dy \, dz = \int_{0}^{h} y \, dy \cdot 2 \int_{0}^{a} z^{2} \, dz = \frac{1}{3} h^{2} a^{3}。 \\ & \quad \text{所以}，\text{原式}=I_{1}+I_{2}+I_{3}=\frac{h^{2} a^{3}}{3}。 \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解答 采用转化为第一类曲面积分的方法来计算。易求得球面方程上任意一点 (x,y,z) 处的单位外法向量为} \\\vec{n}=\left\{ \cos \alpha ,\cos \beta ,\cos \gamma \right\} =\left\{ \frac{x}{a},\frac{y}{a},\frac{z}{a}\right\}, \text{于是} \\\oint_{S}\frac{xdydz+ydzdx+zdxdy}{(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}}=\oint_{S}\frac{xdydz+ydzdx+zdxdy}{a^{3}}=\frac{1}{a^{3}}\oint_{S}xdydz+ydzdx+zdxdy\\=\frac{1}{a^{3}}\oint_{S}(x\cos \alpha +y\cos \beta +z\cos \gamma )dS=\frac{1}{a^{3}}\oint_{S}(x\cdot \frac{x}{a}+y\cdot \frac{y}{a}+z\cdot \frac{z}{a})dS\\=\frac{1}{a^{4}}\oint_{S}(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2})dS=\frac{1}{a^{2}}\oint_{S}dS=\frac{1}{a^{2}}\cdot 4\pi a^{2}=4\pi 。\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\begin{array}{l}\text{解答如图，}\Sigma \text{分为两部分}\Sigma_{1}:z=\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}},\ \Sigma_{2}:z=-\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}},\ \Sigma \text{在}xoy\text{面内的投影}\\D_{xy}:x^{2}+y^{2}\leq a^{2}。\text{所以}\\ \iint_{\Sigma}zdx dy=\iint_{\Sigma_{1}}zdx dy+\iint_{\Sigma_{2}}zdx dy=\iint_{D_{xy}}\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ dx dy-\iint_{D_{xy}}-\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ dx dy\\=2\iint_{D_{xy}}\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}\ dx dy=\iint_{\frac{4}{3}}^{4}\pi a^{3}。\\ \text{同理可得}\iint_{\Sigma}x dy dz=\iint_{\Sigma_{2}}y dz dx=\frac{4}{3}\pi a^{3}。\text{于是}，\text{原积分}=4\pi a^{3} 。\end{array}\end{aligned}
